title: Destiny number (bhagyank) calculator from date of birth
description: Calculate your bhagyank (destiny or life path number) by reducing your full date of birth, with every step shown and the associated planet.
intro: Your bhagyank, also called the destiny or life path number, comes from your full date of birth. Enter the date to see the number, each step of the reduction and the planet traditionally linked with it.

sections.heading: How bhagyank is calculated
body: Write the date as day, month and four-digit year, add every digit together, and keep adding the digits of the result until one digit remains. We show the full sum and each reduction so the calculation is easy to follow.
As with the mulank, each number from 1 to 9 is paired with a planet in Indian numerology: 1 Sun, 2 Moon, 3 Jupiter, 4 Rahu, 5 Mercury, 6 Venus, 7 Ketu, 8 Saturn and 9 Mars.

sections.heading: How it is used
body: Numerologists read the bhagyank alongside the mulank and the name number. Some Western systems keep 11, 22 and 33 as master numbers; the Indian convention used here reduces every total to a single digit, and the tool shows the intermediate sums so you can see both.

faqs.q: What is the difference from the mulank?
faqs.a: The mulank uses only the day of the month; the bhagyank uses the day, month and year together.
No. Following the Indian convention, totals are reduced to one digit. The steps show the intermediate totals.

faqs.q: Which calendar date should I use?
faqs.a: Your date of birth in the Gregorian calendar, as on your birth certificate.

faqs.q: Does numerology use my birth chart?
faqs.a: No. It works only from numbers in the date and the name.
